# @amykit/plugin-file-store

Work records kept as one file per item.

A plugin for [amy](https://github.com/nicolasmelo1/amy). It provides the `store` port.

Every install that runs an engine needs a record store, and this is the local one: each work record is a JSON file under the state directory. It keeps records only, and briefs go through file-brief-store. Pair it with file-queue and an engine.

## What it extends

|  |  |
| :-- | :-- |
| Ports | `store` |
| Actions | _none_ |
| Operations | _none_ |
| Commands | _none_ |
| Events | _none_ |
| Environment | _none_ |

## Install

```sh
amy add @amykit/plugin-file-store
```

Then name it in `~/.amy/config.yaml`:

```yaml
workflows:
  your-profile:
    plugins:
      - "@amykit/plugin-file-store"
```

## Configuration

```yaml
plugins:
  "@amykit/plugin-file-store":
    briefsDirectory: <string>
    directory: "tickets"
```

| Setting | Type | Required | Default | What it is |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `briefsDirectory` | `string` | no |  | deprecated: where briefs are kept, translated to @amykit/plugin-file-brief-store so existing installs keep their briefs |
| `directory` | `string` | no | `tickets` | where the records are kept, relative to the state directory. One per workflow, so two profiles under one `.amy` do not read each other's work |

Every field is checked at boot against the schema this package declares. A key that is
not one of the above is a refusal naming the plugin and the key, not a setting that
silently never applied.
